# OnlineDizi

> > OnlineDizi is a Turkish streaming platform offering foreign TV series, Korean dramas, films, and anime with IMDB ratings and multi-language content.

OnlineDizi.sbs provides a comprehensive catalog of international entertainment content, specializing in foreign series (Yabancı Dizi), Korean dramas (Kore Dizileri), films, and anime. The platform organizes content by IMDB ratings, production countries, release years, and genres, making it easy for Turkish audiences to discover and stream popular shows like Loki, Altered Carbon, 13 Reasons Why, and more.

## Key Topics

- Foreign TV Series (Yabancı Dizi)
- Korean Dramas (Kore Dizileri)
- IMDB Rating Filters
- Streaming Content
- Film Catalog
- Anime Streaming
- Turkish Streaming Platform
- High-Rated Series (9.0+ IMDB)
- International Productions
- TV Series Catalog
- Genre-Based Browsing
- Year-Based Archives
- Popular Shows: Loki, Altered Carbon, 13 Reasons Why
- Game-Show & Reality TV
- Multi-Country Productions

## Main Platform

- [OnlineDizi Homepage](https://onlinedizi.sbs): Main landing page for streaming foreign series, Korean dramas, films, and anime with Turkish subtitles and dubbing options

## Content by Genre

- [Game-Show Series](https://onlinedizi.sbs/tur/game-show): Collection of game-show and reality TV series available for streaming in 2024

## High-Rated Content (IMDB 9.0+)

- [IMDB 10.0 Perfect Rated](https://onlinedizi.sbs/puan/10): Series with perfect 10/10 IMDB ratings
- [IMDB 9.4 Series](https://onlinedizi.sbs/puan/9-4): Top-tier series catalog filtered by 9.4 IMDB rating
- [IMDB 9.3/10 Series](https://onlinedizi.sbs/puan/9-310): High-quality series with 9.3 out of 10 IMDB ratings

## Content by Production Country

- [German Productions](https://onlinedizi.sbs/film-yapim/almanya): Films and series produced in Germany (Almanya)
- [Hungarian Productions](https://onlinedizi.sbs/film-yapim/macaristan): Films and series produced in Hungary (Macaristan)
- [Slovakian Productions](https://onlinedizi.sbs/film-yapim/slovakya): Films and series produced in Slovakia (Slovakya)
